value:
#cloud-config
hostname: grafana-vm

users:
  - default
  - name: sopes
    groups: [adm, sudo]
    sudo:
      - ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: false

chpasswd:
  expire: false
  users:
    - name: sopes
      password: "40qMW6xwLBFTJSpD"
      type: text

ssh_pwauth: true

package_update: true

packages:
  - containerd

write_files:
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/grafana-container.service
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Grafana ejecutado dentro de containerd
      Requires=containerd.service
      After=containerd.service network-online.target
      Wants=network-online.target

      [Service]
      Type=simple
      Restart=always
      RestartSec=5
      TimeoutStartSec=0

      ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/mkdir -p /var/lib/grafana
      ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/chown -R 472:0 /var/lib/grafana

      ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/ctr tasks kill --signal SIGKILL grafana-202200141
      ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/ctr tasks rm grafana-202200141
      ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/ctr containers rm grafana-202200141

      ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/ctr images pull docker.io/grafana/grafana:13.0.1-ubuntu

      ExecStart=/usr/bin/ctr run --rm --net-host --mount type=bind,src=/var/lib/grafana,dst=/var/lib/grafana,options=rbind:rw docker.io/grafana/grafana:13.0.1-ubuntu grafana-202200141

      ExecStop=-/usr/bin/ctr tasks kill --signal SIGTERM grafana-202200141

      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target

runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now containerd
  - systemctl daemon-reload
  - systemctl enable --now grafana-container.service
